metadata.title: EthioRail Logistics | Big or small, we care for all.
metadata.description: Integrated multimodal logistics connecting rail, road, sea, terminals, warehousing, and customs through one coordinated cargo journey.

hero.description: Integrated multimodal logistics connecting rail, road, sea, terminals, warehousing, and customs through one coordinated cargo journey.

intro.bodyOne: Ethio Rail Logistics brings rail, road, port, warehousing, customs, and freight services into one connected logistics journey - helping cargo move from origin to destination with greater coordination.
intro.bodyTwo: From inland movement to international gateways, our role is to connect the stages that keep trade moving.

journey.headline: From origin to global gateway.
journey.description: A multimodal logistics journey depends on every handoff working together. Ethio Rail Logistics connects the stages across inland transport, rail, port, and international freight.
journey.supportingMediaAlt: A freight locomotive pulling container wagons on the railway.

services.description: From inland transport and rail to ports, air freight, warehousing, customs, and international freight, our services connect the stages of the logistics journey.

items.label: Multi-Modal Operation
items.summary: Integrated Ocean → Rail → Road coordination; ERL may issue a single House Bill of Lading (HBL) between maritime gateways and inland East African corridors.
items.mediaAlt: Ethio-Djibouti Railway freight locomotive pulling a container train.

items.label: Ex-Factory Transportation Handling
items.summary: Collect cargo directly at the customer’s production facility or warehouse and coordinate origin consolidation, export staging and entry into the international transport network.
items.mediaAlt: Ethiopian Railway locomotive loading containers under a gantry crane.

items.label: Pre-Clearance
items.summary: Prepare import permits, Letter of Credit (L/C) processing, pre-manifest information and risk screening before customs clearance.
items.mediaAlt: Ethiopian Railway yellow locomotive on a freight line.

items.label: Customs Clearance
items.summary: Coordinate import/export declarations, tariff classification, duty and tax assessment, physical inspections and liaison with customs authorities.
items.mediaAlt: Generic freight container train in a non-Ethiopian rail setting.

items.label: Freight
items.summary: International and regional freight booking across ocean, air and overland transport.

items.label: Transportation (Road & Rail)
items.summary: Coordinate block-train rail operations, heavy-duty trucking and inland transport along core trade corridors.

items.label: Dry Port Handling (CFS Operation)
items.summary: Coordinate CFS and ICD handling, container stripping and stuffing, tallying, secure open storage and covered storage.
items.mediaAlt: Generic container train on a rural freight line.

items.label: Last-Mile Delivery
items.summary: Move cargo from dry ports or regional logistics points directly to the customer’s warehouse, manufacturing plant or project site.
items.mediaAlt: Ethiopian Railway locomotive loading containers under a gantry crane.

items.label: Cargo Insurance
items.summary: Coordinate transit cargo insurance solutions through an appropriate insurer or broker. Coverage, exclusions and terms require shipment-specific confirmation.
items.mediaAlt: Container handling at an Ethiopian intermodal terminal.

items.label: Supply Chain Management
items.summary: Coordinate control-tower oversight, inventory management, vendor coordination, shipment visibility and logistics reporting.
items.mediaAlt: Generic container train on a rural freight line.

items.label: Container Rental & Management
items.summary: Coordinate leasing, rental and equipment pool positioning for standard dry, refrigerated, open-top and flat-rack containers.
items.mediaAlt: Generic container train on a rural freight line.

items.label: Consolidation & Deconsolidation
items.summary: Combine smaller shipments through LCL consolidation, optimize full-container use and coordinate destination deconsolidation.
items.mediaAlt: Ethio-Djibouti Railway freight locomotive pulling a container train.

items.label: Packaging & Labeling
items.summary: Coordinate industrial packing, crating, palletization, shrink wrapping, barcoding and hazard labeling to meet regulatory and cargo safety requirements.
items.mediaAlt: Ethiopian Railway locomotive loading containers under a gantry crane.

metadata.description: Learn how Ethio Rail Logistics combines railway capability and private-sector logistics experience to coordinate multimodal cargo movement.

hero.title: Built around connected movement.
hero.description: Ethio Rail Logistics is an Ethiopian multimodal logistics company established through Ethiopian Railways Corporation and GetAs International PLC.
hero.imageAlt: Ethiopian Railway locomotive on the rail corridor.

intro.title: Rail capability meets logistics experience.
paragraphs: Ethio Rail Logistics combines railway capability with private-sector logistics experience across road and rail coordination, sea transport, customs, freight forwarding, warehousing, terminals, cargo handling, and integrated logistics management.
The purpose is to reduce fragmentation in cargo movement and provide more coordinated end-to-end logistics services around the needs of each shipment.

metadata.description: Explore the working direction behind EthioRail’s connected logistics and corridor-focused approach.

hero.title: A direction for connected logistics.
hero.description: This page describes the working direction of EthioRail’s logistics approach without presenting unverified prose as an official corporate statement.
hero.imageAlt: Rail freight containers being handled along the Ethiopian railway.

intro.title: A direction for connected and sustainable logistics.
paragraphs: Our mission is to provide efficient and cost-effective multimodal transport solutions by integrating the strengths of different transport modes to improve delivery times, reduce logistics costs, and minimize environmental impact.
Our vision is to become a leading provider of integrated logistics solutions that connect Ethiopia to global trade while advancing efficient and sustainable transportation.
